title: Register your child
subtitle: Ask for a place at Ajyal Academy. Fill in the form once — the academy will review your request and contact you.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: The academy will contact you on this number (WhatsApp).

location.label: Preferred location
location.hint: Where would your child like to train?

disease.label: Has a medical condition?
disease.hint: For example asthma or an allergy.

add.limit: You can register up to {{max}} children in one request.

confirm.label: I confirm that the information is correct and that I am the child's parent or guardian.

privacy: The details you send are used only by the academy to review your request.

guardianName.tooLong: The name is too long (120 characters at most)

location.invalid: That location is no longer available. Choose another one.

fullName.tooLong: The name is too long (120 characters at most)

cpr.invalid: The CPR must be exactly 9 digits

dob.invalid: Enter a valid date of birth
